annotations.title: Work out who owes whom, in the fewest payments

description: Given a group of people and the expenses (who paid, how much, who shared it), returns each person's net balance and the smallest set of payments that squares everyone up. Splits equally by default, or by exact amounts. Stateless: nothing is saved. Use create_group instead to make a shared link people can keep adding to.

exact.description: Optional exact amount per person (must add up to amount). Overrides split_between.

split_between.description: Who shared it. Default: everyone, equally.

payments.description: Payments already made between people to settle up.

people.description: Names of everyone in the group (2 to 40, unique).

name: halves_settle_up
title: Work out who owes whom, in the fewest payments
